{'8 月 17 日是印尼獨立 81 周年，多個在港印尼人團體今（23日）在銅鑼灣維園舉行慶祝活動，吸引眾多外傭參與，穿著傳統民俗服飾載歌載舞。同場有多個機構提供中醫、按摩、手工藝攤位，主辦單位指外傭作為香港家庭的照顧者，冀藉活動關懷他們的身心健康。': 'August 17 marks the 81st anniversary of Indonesian independence. Several Indonesian community groups in Hong Kong held a celebration at Victoria Park in Causeway Bay today (the 23rd), attracting many foreign domestic workers who dressed in traditional folk costumes, singing and dancing. Multiple organisations set up booths offering Chinese medicine, massage, and handicrafts. The organiser noted that foreign domestic workers serve as caregivers for Hong Kong families and hoped the event would show care for their physical and mental well-being.'}

{'印尼獨立 81 周年，多個在港印尼人團體今（23日）在銅鑼灣維園舉行慶祝活動，吸引眾多外傭參與，穿著傳統民俗服飾載歌載舞。同場有多個機構提供中西醫、按摩、手工藝攤位，主辦單位指外傭作為香港家庭的照顧者，冀藉活動關懷他們的身心健康。': 'Marking the 81st anniversary of Indonesian independence, several Indonesian community groups in Hong Kong held a celebration at Victoria Park in Causeway Bay today (the 23rd), drawing many foreign domestic workers who wore traditional folk costumes, singing and dancing. On-site, multiple organisations set up booths offering Chinese and Western medicine, massage, and handicrafts. The organiser noted that foreign domestic workers serve as caregivers for Hong Kong families and hoped the event would show care for their physical and mental well-being.'}

{'印尼於 1945 年脫離超過 300 年荷蘭殖民統治， 8 月 17 日為印尼獨立日，是當地重要節日。本港印尼傭工超過 16 萬人，外勞事工中心（MFMW）、香港印尼移工網絡（JBMI）及印尼移工工會（IMWU）多年來都會在 8 月舉辦獨立日慶祝活動，凝聚離鄉別井的在港印傭。': 'Indonesia broke free from over 300 years of Dutch colonial rule in 1945. August 17 is Indonesian Independence Day, an important local holiday. With over 160,000 Indonesian domestic workers in Hong Kong, the Mission for Migrant Workers (MFMW), the Jaringan Buruh Migran Indonesia (JBMI) Hong Kong, and the Indonesian Migrant Workers Union (IMWU) have held Independence Day celebrations every August for many years, bringing together Indonesian domestic workers who have left their hometowns.'}

{'印傭穿民俗服飾同歡 暫忘壓力': 'Indonesian domestic workers in folk costumes celebrate together, momentarily forgetting their stress'}

{'今年活動續於維園舉行，來港打工七年的 Siti 表示，現場參加者多為家庭傭工，平日工作壓力大，獨立日當天也無法慶祝，所以很開心有機會聚在一起，享受如在家鄉的歡樂時光。Siti 今日穿上峇里傳統服飾到場，在她旁邊、同任外傭的 Via 則打扮成東爪哇神話中的女將軍 Srikandi，象徵美麗與力量集於一身的角色，吸引不少人舉機合照。': "This year's event was again held at Victoria Park. Siti, who has worked in Hong Kong for seven years, said most attendees were domestic workers who face heavy daily pressure and cannot celebrate on Independence Day itself. She was therefore delighted to have the chance to gather together and enjoy a happy time as if back home. Siti wore traditional Balinese attire today, while Via, also a domestic worker standing next to her, dressed up as Srikandi, a female warrior from East Javanese mythology symbolising the union of beauty and strength, drawing many people to take photos with them."}

{'本地及印尼團體設攤供義務醫療': 'Local and Indonesian groups set up booths to provide volunteer medical services'}

{'表演舞台當然吸引目光，場內按摩、健康檢查、驗眼攤位也排起長龍。義務按摩師 Tini 表示，她們公園時間學習按摩，趁活動實習技能及服務社群，舒緩外傭長期被肩痛、背痛、頭痛困擾之苦。': 'While the performance stage naturally drew attention, long queues also formed at the massage, health check, and eye examination booths. Tini, a volunteer masseuse, said they learned massage during their time off in the park and took the opportunity to practise their skills and serve the community, easing the long-standing shoulder, back, and head pain suffered by foreign domestic workers.'}

{'主辦次一 MFMW 的社區關係主任唐曉昕表示，中心平時接觸的外傭求助個案多與其工作相關，然而外傭亦非常缺乏日常身心照顧，希望藉嘉年華活動提供「Care for Caregiver」的服務，多年來獲得不少本地醫療界人士支持。': 'Tong Hiu-yan (唐曉昕), Community Relations Officer of co-organiser MFMW, said the cases the centre normally handles involving foreign domestic workers seeking help are mostly work-related. However, domestic workers also severely lack daily physical and mental care, so she hopes the carnival can provide a "Care for Caregiver" service. Over the years, the initiative has received support from many members of Hong Kong\'s medical sector.'}

{'外僱難言病痛「唔想被覺得好難搞」': 'Foreign domestic workers find it hard to speak up about illness: "Don\'t want to be seen as difficult"'}

{'她解釋，雖然勞工法例保障外傭能獲得僱主提供的醫療資源，部份僱主亦很歡迎外傭主動告知健康需要，但是很多外傭因「唔想被僱主覺得好難搞，好難拿捏點為之恰如其分」，而不敢主動要求。中心希望活動有助外傭獲得自我關顧的機會和資訊，同時製造外傭互相關心的機會，讓他們人在異鄉時，仍能被友好群體承載。': 'She explained that although labour laws guarantee foreign domestic workers access to medical resources provided by employers, and some employers welcome domestic workers proactively reporting their health needs, many domestic workers dare not speak up because they "don\'t want employers to see them as difficult, and find it hard to judge what counts as appropriate." The centre hopes the event can help domestic workers access opportunities and information for self-care, while also creating chances for them to care for one another, so that even when far from home they can be supported by a friendly community.'}

{'續跟進宏福苑歷劫外傭個案': 'Continuing to follow up on cases of domestic workers affected by the Wang Fuk Court fire'}

{'今日亦有受宏福苑奪命大火影響的外傭參與，唐曉昕指，歷劫外傭仍然面對不同困境，例如要每日跨區照顧同住及居大埔區安老院的年邁僱主，或照顧因火災而出現情緒問題的長者，亦有外傭精神困擾心陷入抑鬱，幸得僱主體恤解約回鄉休養。MFMW 將繼續為受影響外傭提供支援，跟進有需要的個案。': 'Today, some domestic workers affected by the deadly Wang Fuk Court fire also took part. Tong Hiu-yan noted that the domestic workers who survived the ordeal still face various difficulties. For example, some have to travel across districts daily to care for elderly employers who live with them or reside in care homes in Tai Po, while others care for seniors who developed emotional problems after the fire. Some domestic workers have suffered psychological distress and fallen into depression, though fortunately some understanding employers terminated their contracts so they could return home to recuperate. MFMW will continue to provide support for affected domestic workers and follow up on cases in need.'}
